title: Mike Fritzel's later restaurant
summary: Brief talk about Mike Fritzel's death and the restaurant bearing his name.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Excuse me for interrupting your train of thought, but is Mike Fritzel still here, you think? No, Mike died.
He's dead. Yes. Uh-huh. He, you know, he had this restaurant here at Van State and Lake. About three years ago. Yes, State and Lake.
About four years ago, I remember seeing us later.
Yeah, the place is still there and it's still called Mike. But he was living then, wasn't he? Most people, yeah, most people still call it Mike Fritzel's place.
